subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor Gateway/provider-backed editable dictation in the Control UI now, or pause/close this branch behind the broader web voice direction?
rationale: This is a new user-facing microphone and Gateway RPC surface rather than a strict bug fix, and the branch needs product/security-boundary acceptance in addition to rebase, proof, and a small accessibility fix.

options.title: Sponsor Gateway-backed dictation
options.body: Require a rebase/port to the current chat architecture, the alert accessibility fix, provider/security review, and redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader voice direction
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the broader WebChat STT/TTS provider-routing issue decides the permanent voice API and UI boundary.

options.title: Close this branch
options.body: Close if maintainers do not want core composer dictation or if the contributor does not rebase and prove the current branch.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Gateway-backed dictation
recommendation.body: Require a rebase/port to the current chat architecture, the alert accessibility fix, provider/security review, and redacted live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest feature-history trail for server-side dictation and the current chat composer refactor points to this owner for the product-boundary decision.
